sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:58

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:58:1
items.html: Male and Nukva within him, which are MA and BON, mixed together completely, etc. — there is no left in this hidden Atika, it is all right: For he took the GAR of the Keter of Nekudim, where the GAR of Bina are in wholeness as they were in Nekudim, from the very substance of their emanation, which is the very substance of the light of the Ozen [ear], and they were not flawed by the breaking at all. Therefore there is no discernment of left in Atika, meaning that there is no discernment of a Nukva there that would be lacking Hassadim, as above; rather, it is all right — for even the Nukva of Atik is the discernment of right, meaning that she is in the completion of the Hassadim.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:58:2
items.html: Front and back, etc., and in this there is a wondrous and very great union: However, these discernments of posterior are not revealed in him; rather, the front of MA is on one side, and the front of BON is on the second side, and their two discernments of posterior are between them. And one should not ask from the above that the discernment of back does not apply in GAR, because Atik is different, since the root bottom Hey is concealed within him, as above (page 618, Item 24; and see in the Inner Light there). And understand, for there is no need to elaborate.
